shared_elements: vertical elongated panel or niche shapes
eroded, weathered relief in shallow depth
justification: Both are coarse, weathered stone surfaces bearing vertical elongated recessed elements — A's stacked incised bands and pendant motifs on a shaped monolith, B's tall cut niches in a cliff face — which is the most specific correspondence, and it is a very generic one. The decisive difference is that A carries legible figural/geometric relief (face, disc, curved bands) on a portable free-standing block, while B shows no discernible imagery at all, only quarried or excavated rectangular cavities in a living rock wall.
